purpose: The provider's primary public homepage. Users should be able to learn about the service here.
expectedCharacteristics:
- public
- official
- represents the organization
- suitable for first-time visitors
notExpected:
- login pages
- developer portals
- documentation
- API endpoints
- product-specific applications

purpose: Primary authentication entry point. Where users log in or sign up to access the service.
expectedCharacteristics:
- official login page
- authentication required is normal
notExpected:
- pages that don't involve authentication
- redirect loops that never reach auth

purpose: The page showing API pricing information, costs per token/model, or rate plans.
expectedCharacteristics:
- contains pricing information
- shows costs per token/model
- may require auth if behind paywall
notExpected:
- the root domain (use specific pricing page)
- subscription/plan pages (those go in subscriptionPricingUrl)

purpose: The page showing subscription plans, tiers, or monthly/annual pricing for the service.
expectedCharacteristics:
- contains subscription tiers or plan comparisons
- shows monthly/annual pricing
- may include free tier details
- the value '-' is correct when the provider has no subscription plans
notExpected:
- per-token/per-request API pricing (those go in apiPricingUrl)
- the root domain

purpose: The provider's API documentation. Contains technical reference for developers.
expectedCharacteristics:
- technical API reference
- shows endpoint documentation
- may have versioning (e.g. /docs/v2)
notExpected:
- the root domain (use specific docs page)
- generic help centers over technical docs

purpose: The base URL for API calls. The root endpoint that accepts API requests.
expectedCharacteristics:
- returns JSON on API calls
- may return 401/403 (auth required)
- may return 404 on bare URL but work with a path (e.g. /models)
notExpected:
- web pages that don't return JSON
- endpoints that never respond

purpose: The smallest number of models the provider currently exposes to its customers.
expectedCharacteristics:
- a plain number
- counted from the provider's own model list, not estimated from prose
notExpected:
- a count of the models one tool happens to use
- a number rounded up from a marketing claim

purpose: A short description of the models the provider serves and how they are grouped.
expectedCharacteristics:
- names the model families actually offered
- matches the provider's own model list
notExpected:
- marketing copy with no model names
- a list of models the provider does not serve
